prechange_findings.manual_runner_output: raw print calls for plan, controlled stop, and completion
prechange_findings.boruta_output: selector verbose disabled and no iteration callback
prechange_findings.resource_output: plain Python logger warning plus structured terminal artifacts
prechange_findings.exception_output: parent controlled-stop text and worker result traceback

implemented_architecture.timestamp: UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds and Z suffix
implemented_architecture.terminal_mirror: same canonical JSON record to stderr
implemented_architecture.backpressure_record: logging_backpressure with cumulative and delta counters
implemented_architecture.parent_priority_path: direct lock-protected write and immediate flush
implemented_architecture.listener_thread: one non-daemon parent listener with bounded 2-second join

third_party_policy.catboost: raw output may remain, surrounded by canonical start, heartbeat, completion, failure, or interruption records
third_party_policy.boruta: no library patch or invented progress; supervisor emits truthful time/memory heartbeat
third_party_policy.duplicate_prevention: existing plain console handlers are filtered while a canonical session is active; spawned workers configure one bridge after spawn
